userEnteredValue.stringValue:
The DesignID Lens
Now that you have obtained your DesignID results and walked through the foundations course, we can use them as a lens to explore your Identity in Christ. Let’s collect your data and reflect on what you learned. Remember, the DesignID Assessment is simply a lens, but we will look through it to consider how God uniquely made you to reflect Him.
Your DesignID Snapshot
*Build note: Provide the following content in a clean displayed matrix based off of the person’s scores. Is it possible to pull their specific quick view donut from the report and add here?
Primary Reflection
Secondary Reflection
Integrated reflection
4 reflection capacities
Full shadow matrix
